title: Coach
intro: I'm your {{app}} Coach. Ask me about face exercises, technique, posture or a simple face care routine. I can also put together a quick routine, save a workout you did without the app, or set reminders.
placeholder: Ask, or tell me what you did
clearConfirm: Delete this conversation from your iPhone?
aiNote: AI answers can be wrong. Not medical advice. Long-press an answer to report it.

actions.prepared: I prepared this for you. Check it and confirm below.
actions.nothing: There's nothing to save yet. Tell the Coach which exercises you did or for how long.

consent.title: Before you ask the Coach
consent.what: The Coach is an AI. To answer, your question is sent to our server and processed by an AI model (Cloudflare Workers AI).
consent.sent: Sent: your question, the last few messages of this chat, your focus area, your streak, how many workouts you did this week, and the names and times of your reminders (so the Coach can suggest changes you confirm).
consent.notSent: Not sent: your name, photos, contacts or location. We don't have an account for you.
consent.storage: Our server doesn't keep your questions. The chat history stays on this iPhone, and you can delete it any time.
consent.medical: The Coach gives general fitness and face care tips, not medical advice.
consent.withdraw: You can turn this off in Settings.
